snippet.title: Open Hexagon - Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Open Hexagon is finally out of Early Access! Get it on Steam:
- https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358090/Open_Hexagon/

Discuss on the official Discord:
- https://discord.me/openhexagon

Official website:
- https://openhexagon.org

My website:
- https://vittorioromeo.info

Trailer Soundtrack:
- Dunderpatrullen - Arcadia
  (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hcFYS6Kf-1o)
